title: Senior Customer Success Manager, Talent Platform
description:
About: Hirewell Labs builds an applicant tracking system used by 900+ mid-market recruiting teams. Our CSMs are former recruiters and TA leaders who speak the customer's language.

What you'll do:
- Own a book of 25-30 mid-market accounts through onboarding, adoption, and renewal
- Advise heads of talent on structuring pipelines, interview plans, and hiring metrics inside our platform
- Run quarterly business reviews grounded in hiring outcomes, not vanity dashboards
- Partner with product to translate recruiter pain points into roadmap input
- Build enablement content and playbooks for common recruiting motions

What we're looking for: 6+ years in recruiting, talent acquisition, or TA-adjacent customer success. You have sat in the recruiter's seat and can coach a hiring manager through a broken process. Strong facilitation skills, comfort with renewal targets, and experience with modern ATS tooling. This is a fully remote US role with two optional team offsites a year. Base salary range is $125,000-$150,000 plus equity and full benefits.

title: Senior Manager, Career Coaching Programs
description:
About: Pathlight Careers pairs mid-career professionals with vetted coaches through a structured 12-week program. We are 35 people, profitable, and growing our coaching network past 200 coaches.

What you'll do:
- Own the design and quality of our flagship coaching programs end to end
- Recruit, vet, and develop our coach network; run calibration and quality reviews
- Build curriculum for resume, interview, negotiation, and career-pivot tracks
- Define outcome metrics (placement rate, salary lift, NPS) and report on them monthly
- Coach a small caseload yourself to stay close to the client experience

What we're looking for: 7+ years across recruiting, career coaching, or talent development, with real coaching hours behind you. You have built programs, not just delivered sessions, and you can hold coaches to a quality bar with kindness and clarity. Fully remote across US time zones. Base salary of $130,000-$155,000, meaningful early-stage equity, and a professional development budget.

title: Senior Implementation & Enablement Manager
description:
About: Talentloop is a talent mobility platform helping 300+ companies run internal hiring and career pathing programs. Series B, 180 people, remote-first.

What you'll do:
- Lead implementations for our largest new customers, from kickoff through go-live
- Map customers' recruiting and internal mobility processes into platform workflows
- Design and deliver live training for recruiters, HRBPs, and people managers
- Build reusable enablement assets: guides, videos, and certification paths
- Feed implementation friction back to product and engineering with crisp write-ups

What we're looking for: 5-8 years in recruiting operations, talent programs, or HR-tech implementation. You understand how TA and people teams actually work, you run tight projects, and you teach well. Experience with ATS or HRIS integrations is a plus. Fully remote within the US; travel is optional and rare. Base salary $122,000-$142,000 plus bonus, equity, and a home-office stipend.

title: Customer Success Manager, Enterprise Accounts
description:
About: Recruitful builds sourcing and CRM software for enterprise talent teams. We are 220 people headquartered in Denver with customers across North America.

What you'll do:
- Manage 12-15 enterprise accounts, partnering with VPs of Talent Acquisition
- Drive adoption of sourcing workflows across large, distributed recruiting orgs
- Lead executive business reviews and own gross renewal for your book
- Facilitate on-site and virtual workshops for recruiting teams
- Collaborate with sales on expansion opportunities

What we're looking for: 5+ years in customer success or account management, ideally serving talent acquisition buyers. Recruiting background strongly preferred - our best CSMs have carried a req load themselves. Comfort with Gainsight or similar, strong presentation skills, and a calm approach to escalations. This is a hybrid role: three days a week in our Denver office, with flexibility during crunch periods. Base salary of $110,000-$135,000 plus variable and equity.

title: Content Lead, Career Advice
description:
About: Springboardly is a career-advice product with 400k monthly readers and a fast-growing newsletter. We help people navigate layoffs, pivots, and negotiations with advice that is specific and honest.

What you'll do:
- Own our editorial strategy across the blog, newsletter, and in-product guidance
- Write and edit flagship pieces on job search, interviewing, and salary negotiation
- Manage a bench of freelance writers and subject-matter contributors
- Use search and engagement data to decide what we cover next
- Partner with product to turn the best advice into interactive tools

What we're looking for: Deep, practitioner-level knowledge of hiring - you have been a recruiter, coach, or talent leader and can smell generic advice a mile away. 5+ years creating content or programs, strong editing chops, and comfort owning metrics like organic traffic and newsletter conversion. Fully remote, async-friendly, 28-person team. Compensation is competitive and shared early in the process.

title: Customer Success Manager, Coaching Marketplace
description:
About: Mentora HQ is a B2B coaching marketplace - companies buy coaching benefits for employees, and we match them with our network of 1,500 certified coaches. We serve 250 corporate customers.

What you'll do:
- Manage a portfolio of 40 mid-market customers from launch through renewal
- Onboard HR and L&D admins, configure programs, and drive employee enrollment
- Monitor utilization and coach-match quality; intervene when programs stall
- Run adoption campaigns with customer champions to grow engagement
- Share voice-of-customer insight with product and coach-operations teams

What we're looking for: 3-6 years in customer success, L&D, or coaching operations. You understand what makes coaching programs succeed inside companies and can influence busy HR stakeholders. Organized, data-comfortable, and warm on a video call. Fully remote in the US. Base salary of $105,000-$125,000 depending on experience, plus equity and a coaching benefit of your own.

title: Community Manager, Job Seeker Network
description:
About: OpenRoles is a job board and career community for tech-adjacent professionals, with 600k registered members and a lively forum where job seekers trade advice daily.

What you'll do:
- Own the health of our member community: programming, moderation standards, and growth
- Host weekly events - resume clinics, AMAs with recruiters, negotiation workshops
- Recruit and support volunteer moderators and expert contributors
- Build rituals that turn lurkers into active, supportive members
- Report on community health metrics and tie them to retention

What we're looking for: 5+ years in community, career services, or recruiting-facing roles. You have coached job seekers before and genuinely like doing it in public. Experience running a community platform such as Circle or Discourse, strong writing voice, and good judgment in messy moderation calls. Hybrid from our Austin office, two days a week, with flexibility around events. Compensation discussed in the first conversation.

title: Implementation Specialist, People Platform
description:
About: Crewbase provides workforce management and HR software for hourly employers - restaurants, retail, and logistics. We are 800 people with a large customer operations hub in Chicago.

What you'll do:
- Configure new customer accounts: org structures, pay rules, and scheduling policies
- Run data migrations from legacy HRIS and payroll systems
- Deliver standardized virtual training sessions to store and site managers
- Manage 10-14 concurrent implementations against a 45-day go-live target
- Document edge cases and improve our implementation runbooks

What we're looking for: 2-4 years in software implementation, onboarding, or HR operations. Detail-oriented, comfortable with spreadsheets and light SQL, and calm when a customer's payroll data is a mess. This is a fully on-site position at our Chicago office five days a week - our implementation pods work shoulder to shoulder. Base salary of $78,000-$92,000 plus an annual bonus and strong benefits.

title: Director of Customer Experience
description:
About: Applyra is an enterprise recruiting suite serving Fortune 1000 talent organizations. We are 1,400 employees globally, with CX teams in New York, Dallas, and Dublin.

What you'll do:
- Lead a 45-person organization spanning support, success, and professional services
- Own retention, CSAT, and services margin targets for the Americas
- Build the operating cadence: capacity planning, escalation paths, exec sponsorship
- Partner with product and sales leadership on the enterprise customer journey
- Develop managers and build succession depth across three teams

What we're looking for: 10+ years in customer-facing roles with at least 5 years managing managers in B2B SaaS, ideally HR tech. You think in systems and dashboards, are fluent in enterprise renewal mechanics, and have run support operations at scale. Hybrid from our Manhattan office, three days weekly, with quarterly travel to Dallas. Base salary of $175,000-$210,000 plus bonus and equity.

title: Junior Customer Success Associate
description:
About: JobNest is a niche job board for early-career healthcare workers. We are a 20-person remote team helping nurses and techs find their first and second jobs.

What you'll do:
- Answer employer and job-seeker questions over email and chat, owning first response
- Onboard new employer accounts and help them write postings that convert
- Maintain our help center and record short how-to videos
- Flag recurring issues to the product team with clear reproduction notes
- Keep CRM records tidy and assist the senior CSM with renewal prep

What we're looking for: 0-2 years of experience in support, customer success, or recruiting coordination. Clear writer, fast learner, genuinely kind to stressed-out job seekers. Familiarity with Zendesk or similar is a plus but not required. Fully remote within US time zones with a real training plan and mentorship from day one. Base salary of $58,000-$68,000 plus benefits and a learning stipend.

title: Career Services Advisor (Commission-Based)
description:
About: LaunchTrack Coaching Group sells premium career-coaching and resume packages to executives in transition. Our advisors consult with inbound leads and enroll them in the right program.

What you'll do:
- Take 6-10 scheduled consultations daily with prospective clients
- Diagnose each client's situation and recommend a coaching package ($2,500-$15,000)
- Follow up persistently on your pipeline; most enrollments take 3-5 touches
- Hand enrolled clients to our delivery team and stay involved through week one
- Hit monthly enrollment targets and attend daily sales stand-ups

What we're looking for: 3+ years in coaching, recruiting, or consultative sales, and comfort selling high-ticket services. You are energized by targets and unafraid of follow-up calls. Important: this role is 100% commission-based with no base salary - advisors earn 12-18% of enrolled package value, and our top performers earn well into six figures. Fully remote with flexible hours. Training on our sales methodology is provided in your first two weeks.

title: Field Implementation Consultant, Talent Systems
description:
About: Workwise Systems delivers talent acquisition and workforce software to hospital systems, manufacturers, and government agencies. Our field consulting team leads complex, on-premises deployments.

What you'll do:
- Lead multi-month ATS and talent-system implementations at client sites
- Facilitate on-site discovery workshops with HR, IT, and operations leaders
- Run train-the-trainer programs for client super-users, in person
- Manage project governance: steering committees, risk logs, cutover plans
- Represent Workwise at client go-lives, often across multiple facilities

What we're looking for: 6+ years implementing enterprise HR or talent systems, with strong workshop facilitation skills and executive presence. Please note: this role requires 100% travel - consultants are at client sites Monday through Thursday every week, flying out of any major US airport, with Fridays remote for documentation. Base salary of $115,000-$140,000 plus a travel premium, full expenses, and airline status that takes care of itself.

title: Onboarding Coordinator, HR Software
description:
About: PeopleFirst Suite sells payroll and benefits administration software to small businesses across the Midwest. Our Columbus onboarding center gets every new customer live within 30 days.

What you'll do:
- Schedule and coordinate onboarding calls between customers and senior specialists
- Enter and verify customer employee data ahead of first payroll runs
- Answer inbound calls from customers mid-onboarding and triage their questions
- Track onboarding milestones in our internal system and chase missing paperwork
- Support the team with documentation and checklist upkeep

What we're looking for: 0-2 years of office, coordination, or customer service experience. Accurate with data, friendly on the phone, and comfortable juggling a busy calendar. Note that this is a fully on-site position at our Columbus office, Monday through Friday, 8:30 to 5:00 - our onboarding floor works as one team in one room. Base salary of $48,000-$56,000 with health coverage, 401(k) match, and paid training.
